specApproval: not obtained (autonomous run); implementing the user's explicit null/zero rule
scenarios: PLT, LYR, SEC and PCS accept missing, null, empty and whitespace input; each normalizes to null.
Numeric zero, negative zero and numeric text zero normalize to null independently for each pack field.
Positive whole and fractional quantities remain exact, including numeric text input.
Negative, nonfinite, oversized and nonnumeric pack values remain invalid.
New requests and additional lines store null pack values; edits can clear a pack value and render it blank.
Every REST SO creation path (direct, estimate conversion, discounted and waitlist) posts explicit null for missing/zero custom pack columns.
The SuiteScript SO creation paths leave empty pack columns blank and retain supplied positive quantities.
Sales quantity, price, discount, item identity, UOM, purchase-order payloads and duplicate-order protection remain unchanged.

failureModel.zero sent or sourced on SO: outbound transport and SuiteScript record-boundary assertions
failureModel.positive pack count lost: property tests for exact preservation and independent fields
failureModel.pricing changed: existing SO pricing suites and unchanged financial field assertions

setup.dependencies: existing Node, node:test, fast-check, c8, TypeScript, ESLint and Playwright only; no additions
setup.git: preserve all pre-existing changes; no commit or reset
setup.tests: bounded disposable containers in mbbs-tests.slice, standard isolated Compose database, registered teardown before launch
setup.production: no live sales orders or production database changes during verification
